nodes.name: Process One Topic at a Time

parameters.text:
=You are a senior publication editor, research strategist, and writer for EveryGyan (everygyan.com).

TOPIC: {{ $json.topic }}

Generate an authoritative, engaging ~500-word article formatted in clean Markdown, alongside all required metadata matching the EveryGyan CMS specifications.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. WORD COUNT: The article body must be approximately 500 words of substantive, high-value content.
2. MARKDOWN FORMATTING: Structure the content with:
   - ## Key Takeaways & Overview
   - ### Deep-Dive Insights & Analysis (with bullet points or comparison)
   - ### Real-World Examples or Practical Tips
   - ## Editorial Conclusion & Next Steps
3. CATEGORY: Map automatically to one of: "Tech", "Travel", "Learning", "Health & Wellness", or "Latest News". (e.g. for iOS or iPhone topics, use "Tech").
4. STATUS: Must strictly be "draft".
5. UNSPASH COVER IMAGE: Provide a high-resolution, relevant Unsplash photo URL.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return ONLY a valid, raw JSON object. Do not wrap in markdown fences (```json) and do not include conversational greetings.

STRICT JSON SCHEMA:
{
  "title": "Engaging, high-converting article title",
  "slug": "url-friendly-lowercase-slug-using-hyphens",
  "excerpt": "A concise 1-2 sentence overview for cards and RSS (under 160 characters).",
  "category": "Tech",
  "tags": ["Technology", "iOS", "Apple", "Updates"],
  "cover_image": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1510557880182-3d4d3cba35a5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80",
  "cover_caption": "Latest Apple iOS operating system features overview.",
  "read_time": "3 min read",
  "content": "Full ~500-word Markdown article text...",
  "seo_title": "SEO title under 60 characters | EveryGyan",
  "seo_description": "SEO description under 160 characters with strong call to action.",
  "table_of_contents": [
    { "id": "key-takeaways-overview", "level": 2, "title": "Key Takeaways & Overview" },
    { "id": "deep-dive-insights-analysis", "level": 3, "title": "Deep-Dive Insights & Analysis" },
    { "id": "editorial-conclusion-next-steps", "level": 2, "title": "Editorial Conclusion & Next Steps" }
  ],
  "references": [
    { "title": "Official Apple Developer Documentation", "url": "https://developer.apple.com" },
    { "title": "TechCrunch Analysis", "url": "https://techcrunch.com" }
  ]
}
